comment: Bluetooth policy for the S10+ (beyond2lte). Read by tools/s10plus/a33/nuxel-bluetooth-diag.sh. The radio is a Broadcom BCM4375 (BT 5.0) behind the Samsung SDIO/PCIe glue. Adapter presence, rfkill state, module binding and firmware (HCD) load are ENUMERATED and the FIRST failing stage is reported. A registered module is not proof that the radio works and no pairing is claimed from configuration alone: the terminal verdict is NEEDS_OWNER_TEST until a real peer pairs.

stack.comment_auto_enable: AutoEnable=false: nothing powers the adapter at boot. The owner enables it explicitly, so a failed bring-up can never make the phone behave unexpectedly at startup.

verdicts.READY_FOR_PAIRING: adapter enumerated, not rfkill-blocked, bluetoothd active — an owner may pair, still NEEDS_OWNER_TEST
verdicts.RFKILL_BLOCKED: adapter exists but rfkill soft/hard blocks it — a switch, not a code change
verdicts.BLOCKED_FIRMWARE: driver/module path present but no HCD firmware file found in any candidate directory
verdicts.BLOCKED_HARDWARE: no adapter node AND no bluetooth rfkill entry AND no driver module — the radio has not come up at all
verdicts.PARTIAL: some stages present, some missing — read the per-stage lines

pairing_test.comment: Owner procedure only. The repository scripts the safe parts (enable adapter, scan, list) and never pairs on its own.
steps: prepare a second device (phone/laptop/speaker) with Bluetooth on and discoverable
nuxel-bluetooth-diag.sh on                # power the adapter (explicit owner action)
nuxel-bluetooth-diag.sh scan 15           # bounded scan; note the peer MAC
bluetoothctl pair <MAC> && bluetoothctl trust <MAC> && bluetoothctl connect <MAC>
play 10 s of audio to a speaker, or send a file to a laptop, to prove the DATA path
nuxel-bluetooth-diag.sh off               # leave the adapter as you found it
evidence_required_for_promotion: nuxel-bluetooth-diag.sh status prints adapter=hci0 and an unblocked rfkill line
the peer appears in `scan` output with its MAC
pair+connect succeed and the peer shows as connected in bluetoothctl
the data path is exercised (audio or a file transfer), not just a link
